__readme: Shared parity fixtures for the predicate wire shape. ONE FILE, byte-identical in both repos: mcpjam-inspector at sdk/tests/fixtures/predicates-parity-fixtures.json (checked by the Zod `predicateSchema`) and mcpjam-backend at tests/convex/fixtures/predicates-parity-fixtures.json (checked by the Convex `predicateValidator` plus `assertValidPredicate`, through the real mutation boundary). Pinned by `predicates-parity-fixtures` in convex/lib/mirrors.json, so editing one side without the other fails CI. Every `accept` row must parse on both sides; every `reject` row must fail on both. The policy `role` has two spellings of one value — canonical `required`, legacy `gating` — and both must be accepted by both validators; `severity` still requires `advisory` under either. When adding a predicate kind, edit BOTH validators and this file in the same PR — a kind with no accept row here has no proof the two validators agree about it.
